verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr links to its own fiscal calendar ('Voir le calendrier fiscal') and publishes at least one exact date window (online correction service open 29 July to 30 November 2026), so deadline publication is partly evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows a published penalty or late-interest schedule with exact figures. missing for 10: published penalty rates and late-payment interest schedule with exact figures, evidence of exact filing deadlines for business/founder obligations (calendar content itself), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures

citations.quote: Le service de correction des déclarations de revenus en ligne est ouvert du 29 juillet au 30 novembre 2026 inclus.
